name: Merge Monsters! 💀
desc:
💀 Merge monsters to discover rarer ones! 💀

Welcome to Merge Monsters! In this game, you can:

Combine monsters to create unique and rare creatures! 🐣
Customize with fun trails, themes, and decorations! 🎨
Hatch, trade, and grow your pet collection! 🐰
Earn rare loot to unlock upgrades and special rewards!
Climb the leaderboards and show off your best monsters! 🏆

Start merging now and build the ultimate monster collection!
